ALL that certain lot, parcel or tract of land, situate and lying in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden and State of New Jersey being more particularly described in accordance with a survey made by Bach Associates, dated June 14, 2004 as follows:

Beginning at a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 10, Block 76 where intersected by the Southerly line of Lot 12.12, Block 76, said point also being in the division line of Lots 12.12 and 12.13, Block 76 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned, and running; thence

(1) Along the said Northeasterly line of Lot 10, Block 76, North 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds West, 20.08 feet to a point in same; thence

(2) Along the common line of Lots 12.11 and 12.12, Block 76, North 61 degrees 11 minutes 33 seconds East, 83.79 feet to a point in the Southwesterly line of Lot 12.06, Block 76; thence

(3) Along said Southwesterly line of Lots 12.06 and 12.07, South 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds East, 20.04 feet to a point in same; thence

(4) Along the common line of Lots 12.12 and 12.13, South 61 degrees 11 minutes 33 seconds West, 82.47 feet to the point and place of beginning.

common_failure_modes: NW/SE bearings use different seconds (33 vs 34 vs 35) across deeds for same lot line
notes: Lot 12.12 is an interior lot in the Willits Court subdivision, bounded by Lot 10 (SW), Lot 12.11 (NW), Lots 12.06/12.07 (NE), and Lot 12.13 (SE). Approximately 20 ft wide by 83 ft deep.
